```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Define Directories
home_dir <- "../../" # Home directory
raw_dir <- paste0(home_dir,"data/raw") # Raw data

## Define Parameters
# Locations
region <- c("MORRAZO","OVIEDO","PORTO")
```

## Introduce Data

```{r Load data}
## path to folders containing txt files
path <- list.files(path = raw_dir, 
                   pattern="\\.csv", 
                   full.names = TRUE)
## Load dataframe from each regions
files <- list()
for (i in seq_along(region)){
  files[[i]] <- read.table(path[grep(region[i],path)],
               header = TRUE,
               fill = TRUE,
               na.strings = c(""," ", "na"),
               sep = ",")
}
names(files) <- region
```

## Samples

```{r Sample size}
## Number of samples per site
for (i in seq_along(files)){
  # Number of Dermal Swabs by habitat
  print(paste("Dermal Swabs in",region[i],"by Habitat"))
  print(
    table(files[[i]][
      !is.na(files[[i]]$Skin.swab), # Exclude samples without dermal swabs
      ]$Habitat)
    )
# Number of Dermal Swabs by Location
  print(paste("Dermal Swabs in",region[i],"by Location"))
  print(
    table(files[[i]][
      !is.na(files[[i]]$Skin.swab), # Exclude samples without dermal swabs
      ]$Location)
    )
}

```

## Statistical Power

[Thresholds for interpreting the effect size](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC7745163/table/t3/?report=objectonly)

Animal studies usually recommend using low sample sizes on ethical grounds, to establish large effects before proceeding with further study.

[Recommended sample sizes.](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC7745163/table/t5/?report=objectonly)

```{r Statistical Power}
## Determine statistical power between sites
pwr_site <- list()
for (i in seq_along(files)){
# Defined as number of sites
k = sum(                       # the number of sites
  table(files[[i]][
    !is.na(files[[i]]$Skin.swab), # with skin swabs
    ]$Location
    )>=5                           # and at least 5 samples
  )
# Defined as the minimum sample size among all sites
n = 5
f = NULL
sig.level = 0.05
power = 0.85
pwr::pwr.anova.test(k = k,
                    n = n,
                    f = f,
                    sig.level = sig.level,
                    power = power) -> pwr_site[[i]]
}
```
